Le locataire a 1 mois pour accepter, ref: The tenant has 1 month to accept, refuse and stay, or leave; silence counts as acceptance. If the tenant refuses and stays, the landlord has 1 month to ask the TAL to set the rent. For 2026, the TAL’s base rate is 3.1%.
Le locataire avise par écrit, avec le no: The tenant gives written notice, with the name and address of the proposed person. The landlord has 15 days to reply; silence counts as consent (C.C.Q., arts. 1870 and 1871).
